{{Quote|During our attack on the Mugaari/Rebel weapons area, the Rebels launched a raid on Outpost-D34.|Imperial briefing officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''Capture of Outpost D-34''' was a battle fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While a strike force, consisting of the frigate [[Fogger]], was [[Battle of the Tungra sector|attacking]] the [[Mugaari cargo loading area]] in the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] launched an attack on [[Outpost D-34]] and was able to capture it.

==The Battle==
The details of the battle was unknown but it was said that Outpost D-34 had put up a valiant fight despite falling to the Rebels.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|It fell to the Rebels, despite a valiant fight.|[[Imperial briefing officer]]|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
With the outpost captured the rebels began looting it for equipment. However their foothold on it would not last for long as the strike force returned to [[Recapture of Outpost D-34|recapture]] the base.

This event also attracted the attention of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]] as the most disturbing element was that the Rebels had timed this attack while the bulk of Imperials forces were engaged in another sector. They believed that this was no coincidence.
